name: Moondrop and Sundew
source:
You're just an average photographer in an average town trying to get some good photos for your blog. Surely that mysterious mountain that's supposedly cursed that everyone keeps talking about will be the perfect place to get some pictures! You're pretty smart, you won't fall for any of the horror movie cliches. You'll be fine.

Well, until you're not.

But luckily for you, a kind stranger on the mountain is more than willing to help! How wonderful!

Although the more you hang around him, the more of a bad feeling you get in your chest. As though he was familiar, and not in the good way.

[From [url=https://obsessedgames505.itch.io/shadowdrop]itch.io[/url]]
